scientific_integrity: Exact integer-chain proof, including both directions of the boundary comparison; finite checker independently verifies defining identities and one integral torsion example; no independent scientific review was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only degrees zero and one, for finite hypergraphs whose every vertex is covered by a hyperedge. No higher-degree Gamma-homology comparison is claimed. Priority searches cannot prove absolute bibliographic uniqueness.
title: Degree-one \(\Gamma\)-cubical homology is simplicial-closure homology
